label: fact lost?
instructions: quoted_new replaced the memory in quoted_old after the conversation in quoted_messages. Does it lose a part of the old memory that the conversation didn't change?
true: Lost: a detail of the old memory that is still true is missing or blurred.
false: Kept: every still-true detail of the old memory is in the new one.
state_note: memory D40 (B4 'Memory rewrite', lost a fact): one per replacement written by the run.
